title: data-model.md has no contract row for WbItem.edited_at or WbMessage.edited_at
body: The v3.2.3 release pre-flight reported contract_check FINDINGS: schema/board.schema.json publishes edited_at on WbItem and WbMessage, and intent/st/ST0056/data-model.md has no row for either under wb_node#wb_item and wb_node#wb_message. The gap is older than 3.2.3: at v3.2.2 the board schema already carries edited_at (2 occurrences) and data-model.md carries none. The check is rostered manual and does not gate a release. Remedy: add the two rows to data-model.md, then contract_check should report 0 findings.
